exposure: theory of planned behavior (TPB) constructs (intention, affective attitude, perceived behavioral control)
multi-process action control (M-PAC) constructs (planning, habits, exercise identity)
cohort: 264 participants (132 couples) who were two months into parenting their first child.
finding: Intention to be physically active predicted MVPA for mothers but not fathers, with the intention-MVPA gap for both parents being influenced by planning, habits, and exercise identity from the M-PAC framework.
